facts.fact: 岛上只剩最后一点米和咸鱼
facts.anchor: We eat the last of the rice, the dried fish.

facts.fact: 他从坟地附近的悬崖边采来野花
facts.anchor: He brings me flowers picked from the cliff edge, near the gravesite

facts.fact: 厨房桌上还有 Kochek 那支烟烧出的永久焦痕
facts.anchor: the hole burned permanently into the wood from Kochek’s cigarette

facts.fact: 夜里他低声承认不知道该怎么保护她、怎么救他们
facts.anchor: I don’t know how to protect ye now. I don’t know how to save us.

facts.fact: 两人都以为这一夜就是最后一夜
天没亮他就醒了——梦里的死没有成
facts.anchor: We didn’t die, as my dreams foretold. Not yet.

facts.fact: 她求他别杀鸡，他们已经饿到极限
他带回一颗桃；桃子来自岸上的果园
雨还在下，可海不见了，面前是一整片绿色的大陆
facts.anchor: Rain still dapples the sky, but the sea is gone.

facts.fact: 林子的缺口处走出一个男孩
